baseline_first.method: Serial TestClient HTTP/JSON through public handlers. Eight independent backend processes; process spawn/startup, archive import, and OS disk-cache eviction excluded. Cold reopen loads checkpoint and evaluates both panes through the existing indicator API. Warm step/rewind measures both panes; older page includes the current response and one older pivot and pool page in each pane. New view timings are separate architecture and payload measurements. Three initial warm-up cutoffs before each step group.
baseline_first.counter_scope: Instrumented research db.connect and SQL trace, hashlib.file_digest calls, Parquet constructor, read_row_groups and iter_batches. OS file reads/bytes and SQLite engine I/O are unobserved; zero means no instrumented calls.

baseline_repeat.method: Serial TestClient HTTP/JSON through public handlers. Eight independent backend processes; process spawn/startup, archive import, and OS disk-cache eviction excluded. Cold reopen loads checkpoint and evaluates both panes through the existing indicator API. Warm step/rewind measures both panes; older page includes the current response and one older pivot and pool page in each pane. The new lazy panel opens on one selected pane. Open-panel step/rewind includes both legacy indicator calls plus one new list request. New inspection includes list and explicit selection with the full receipt. These serial backend/API timings omit browser rendering, UI scheduling and transport.
baseline_repeat.counter_scope: Instrumented research db.connect and SQL trace, hashlib.file_digest calls, Parquet constructor, read_row_groups and iter_batches. OS file reads/bytes and SQLite engine I/O are unobserved; zero means no instrumented calls.

candidate.counter_scope: Instrumented research db.connect and SQL trace, hashlib.file_digest calls, full verification calls plus actual bytes copied into verified snapshots, and Parquet constructor, read_row_groups and iter_batches. limitations: Eight cold processes per applicable workload and 30 observations per warm workload. Cold restarts the Python application with the saved database and operating-system cache still present. Warm samples use one process and each lane reuses the same ordered cutoffs.
Replaying the baseline twice shows local run-to-run variance. Treat sub-millisecond changes and isolated p95 shifts as noisy observations. No concurrent full suites during the candidate run.

Browser rendering, transport, and request concurrency are outside the serial public-handler workload. The ordinary UI fetches no new evidence while the inspector is closed. The open-panel timings add one current-pane request per step; the selected receipt benchmark includes list and drill-down.

The original endpoint returned 404 in both panes before this change, so new-list and new-receipt workloads have no like-for-like baseline. Legacy page requests can inspect older pivots or pools through existing components.

Peak working set is process-wide. The preliminary candidate instrumented the artifact verifier by eagerly importing its module before measurement, increasing common peak memory. The final candidate installs that hook lazily at the actual replay archive call site. The untouched baseline excluded this full-verify counter and its common workload reported zero Parquet opens.
